spans.s:
सु-ग (गं) 1.
n. Fæces.
a. Moving
gracefully; easily accessible;
plain; well got rid of.

सुगण् (ण्)
a. Counting well, easily
counted.

सुगणित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Easily or well calculated.

सु-गत (तः) 1.
m. A
Buddha. a.
Passed; well bestowed.

सु-गन्ध (न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
a.
Fragrant. 1

.
n. Small cumin seed; fragrant
grass; blue lotus;
Sandal. m.
Sulphur; odour; a trader. 1.
f.
Plants of several kinds.

सु-गन्धक (कः) 1.
m. Sulphur; the
orange; kind of gourd.

सु-गन्धि (न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि)
a. Fragrant;
pious.
m. A perfume, fragrance;
sort of mango.
f. Name of se-
veral fragrant plants.
n. A drug
and perfume; root of long-pep-
per; fragrant grass.

सु-गन्धिक (कः) 1.
m. A large sort of
rice; incense; sulphur.
n. White
lotus.

सुगन्धि-कुसुम (मः) 1.
m. Nerium with
yellow flowers. 1.
f. A plant,
Trigonella corniculata.

सुगन्धिता (ता) 1.
f. Fragrance.

सुगन्धि-मूल (लं) 1.
n. Root of the
Andropogon muricatum. 1.
f.
Ichneumon plant.

सुगन्धि-मूषिका (का) 1.
f. The musk
rat or shrew.

सु-गम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Accessible; easy,
practicable; plain.

सु-गहन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Thick, imper-
vious.
f. Enclosure round the
place of sacrifice.

सु-गुप्त (प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
a. Secret.

सुगुप्ति (प्तिः) 2.
f. Secrecy.

सु-गृह (हः) 1.
m. The tailor bird.

सु-गृहीत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Held fast or
firmly; applied auspiciously.

सुगृहीत-नामन् (मा) 5.
m. An epi-
[]
thet of
Yudhishthira and others
whose names it is auspicious to
repeat in the morning.

सुग्राह्य (ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
a. Easy to be
laid hold of.

सुग्रीव (वः-वा-वं)
m. Horse of
Krish-
na's car; a monkey king and ally
of
Rāma; Shiva; Indra; name
of a number of objects having
a handsome neck.
a. Handsome-
necked.

सुग्रीवेश (शः) 1.
m. Rāma.

सुग्ल (ग्लः-ग्ला-ग्लं)
a. Very weary.
